title: Automatic Captions
description: Drop a video — transcribe it, then style, time and place the captions exactly how you want.
dropLabel: Drop a video here or click to browse
hint: Runs on your computer. The transcript is a fast starting point — edit anything that's wrong before generating.
editHint: Fix any words the transcription got wrong, add a missed word or remove one, then drag it into place on the timeline below.
fewWordsWarning: Very little speech was found — check the video has clear audio.

language.label: Language spoken in the video
language.hintPrecise: Frame-accurate word timing for this language.
language.hintApprox: Word timing is approximate for this language — check it on the timeline.
language.hintAuto: Choosing the language yourself is more reliable than auto-detect.
